title: Fibre operator evidence
subtitle: Two captures, with observations, assumptions and missing evidence kept visible.
evidence_fallback: Refer to the measured values and collection coverage below. Missing evidence is not a zero or a pass.
memory_note: RSS, cgroup memory and file cache overlap. Do not add them together. An unlimited service limit does not prove unlimited ancestor capacity.
capacity_note: max_connections × max_concurrent_streams × 132 MiB. This is a version-specific receive buffer model, not measured RAM or a whole-process memory ceiling.
capacity_assumption: Increasing connections also increases modeled receive buffers. Current low RSS does not establish safe load capacity; FD and shared-host limits require separate evidence.
config_note: Configuration on disk is evidence of file contents, not proof of every effective runtime setting.
Mismatch: Identity mismatch · side by side only
legacy_note: Legacy snapshots lack host / boot identity. Heuristic changes assume the same host and service lifetime from matching PID, restart count and start evidence. This short interval does not establish a memory leak or long-term growth.
rate_note: A missing change or rate means continuity, time, or a required value was not established. CPU nanoseconds per second are not whole-host CPU utilization.
storage_note: Observed bytes describe the traversed entries. Partial scans are not totals. Files may change during collection. A staging age above 900 seconds is an investigation signal, not proof of an orphan.
no_scans: Storage directory measurements were not collected.
fd_note: has_open_fd describes observed open descriptors only. False requires a complete, stable inspection; unknown remains unknown.
metrics_note: Only selected metric names and values are public. Labels and endpoint addresses are omitted. Repeated names may represent different private label sets; do not sum them without identity evidence.
no_metrics: No selected metric samples are available. An HTTP response alone does not establish current Fibre metrics.
cost_note: Measured before final serialization. Parent and worker costs are separate. Peaks are not additive; incomplete worker checkpoints do not represent total cost or SSH transfer overhead.
no_usage: Collector self-measurement is unavailable in this capture.
privacy_note: Public projection: host names, IP addresses, paths, identities, raw labels and arbitrary log text are excluded. Keep original snapshots private. No overall readiness score is computed.
timestamp_note: Capture times are shown in UTC. Values are observations at collection time, not continuous monitoring.
finding.collection_issues.title: Collection coverage
finding.collection_issues.impact: Collection errors limit what this report can conclude; they do not by themselves prove a node fault.
finding.collection_issues.recommendation: Resolve missing inputs or access limitations before relying on affected checks.
finding.collection_issues.verification: Inspect collection statuses and repeat the bounded read-only capture.
finding.service_state.title: Service state
finding.service_state.impact: An active service confirms process state only, not synchronization, reachability or historical uptime.
finding.service_state.recommendation: Review any inactive or unavailable service observation alongside application evidence.
finding.service_state.verification: Read systemd service state and compare with the captured application status.
finding.process_stability.title: Process identity stability
finding.process_stability.impact: A process change during capture can mix observations from different lifetimes.
finding.process_stability.recommendation: Use identity-stable captures for temporal comparisons.
finding.process_stability.verification: Compare PID and start identity before and after capture without restarting services.
finding.host_memory.title: Host memory headroom
finding.host_memory.impact: Available host memory is shared by all workloads and can change under load.
finding.host_memory.recommendation: Evaluate the capacity model together with shared workloads and cgroup limits.
finding.host_memory.verification: Read MemAvailable and the service and ancestor limits in this report.
finding.service_memory.title: Memory accounting
finding.service_memory.impact: RSS and cgroup values describe different overlapping scopes; file cache is not anonymous heap.
finding.service_memory.recommendation: Keep each memory component separate and compare like-for-like measurements.
finding.service_memory.verification: Inspect RSS, memory.current, anon, file and kernel values without summing overlaps.
finding.cgroup_limits.title: Cgroup limits
finding.cgroup_limits.impact: Ancestor limits can constrain a service even when its own memory limit is unlimited.
finding.cgroup_limits.recommendation: Review finite limits across the hierarchy before increasing concurrency.
finding.cgroup_limits.verification: Read memory.high and memory.max for the service and its ancestors.
finding.memory_events.title: Memory events
finding.memory_events.impact: OOM and limit events are counters for their cgroup lifetime, not proof of a current incident.
finding.memory_events.recommendation: Investigate nonzero counters and use valid continuity evidence for new-event deltas.
finding.memory_events.verification: Read memory.events and compare only within a verified cgroup lifetime.
finding.file_descriptors.title: File descriptor capacity
finding.file_descriptors.impact: Open descriptors must be compared with the effective process limit; FDSize is not an open-FD count.
finding.file_descriptors.recommendation: Review descriptor headroom before changing connection counts.
finding.file_descriptors.verification: Count the process FD entries and read its soft and hard limits.
finding.data_filesystem.title: Data filesystem headroom
finding.data_filesystem.impact: Filesystem free space and logical Fibre budget measure different things. Shared mounts share capacity.
finding.data_filesystem.recommendation: Review free bytes and inodes on the actual data filesystem.
finding.data_filesystem.verification: Read data mount capacity; do not infer physical disk separation from device IDs alone.
finding.storage_scan.title: Storage scan completeness
finding.storage_scan.impact: A bounded scan may stop early. Observed apparent and allocated bytes are distinct and are not guaranteed reclaimable space.
finding.storage_scan.recommendation: Read completeness, stop conditions and counts before interpreting storage numbers.
finding.storage_scan.verification: Inspect worker checkpoints, scan duration and errors; keep files untouched.
finding.aged_files.title: Aged staging observations
finding.aged_files.impact: Age above 900 seconds is a diagnostic threshold. Open-FD evidence does not prove progress, abandonment or safe deletion.
finding.aged_files.recommendation: Investigate repeated observations alongside upload activity; do not automatically remove files.
finding.aged_files.verification: Compare mtime, bytes and has_open_fd with stable process identity.
finding.app_sync.title: Consensus synchronization evidence
finding.app_sync.impact: A captured synchronization flag is a point-in-time observation; missing RPC data is not proof of synchronization failure.
finding.app_sync.recommendation: Check verified local status and block progression when synchronization evidence is incomplete.
finding.app_sync.verification: Read the configured loopback status endpoint without changing service state.
finding.metrics_evidence.title: Metrics target and freshness
finding.metrics_evidence.impact: OTLP export success or HTTP 200 alone does not prove current samples from this Fibre process.
finding.metrics_evidence.recommendation: Use a known exporter or metrics file and verify target identity and freshness.
finding.metrics_evidence.verification: Inspect the configured metrics pipeline and timestamps without guessing ports.
finding.signing_latency.title: Signing latency evidence
finding.signing_latency.impact: The supported median check requires the right core version, at least 50 successful samples and current target evidence. Fibre endorsement timing is a different measurement.
finding.signing_latency.recommendation: Treat warm-up, unknown versions and stale samples as insufficient evidence, not a pass.
finding.signing_latency.verification: Verify signing_latency_median_seconds, successful histogram counts, target and sample freshness; the supported threshold is 0.010 seconds.
finding.unknown_finding.title: Additional check
finding.unknown_finding.impact: This report does not have a translated template for the supplied check.
finding.unknown_finding.recommendation: Use a matching collector and report version.
finding.unknown_finding.verification: Review the private source snapshot for additional evidence.
reason.gauge_unverified: Temporal continuity or a valid duration is missing; observations remain side by side.
reason.monotonic: Interval verified with a monotonic clock.
reason.estimated_wall_clock: Estimated from wall-clock capture starts; clock changes and sequential reads can affect the interval.
reason.invalid_duration: A positive compatible duration is unavailable; no temporal rate is established.
reason.counter_reset: Counter decreased or reset; delta and rate are unavailable.
reason.gauge_difference: Difference between observed gauges; this does not prove continuous growth.
reason.environment_difference: Difference between environments, not a temporal change.
reason.environment_counters: Counters from different environments are not temporal deltas.
reason.counter_unverified: Counter continuity is neither verified nor explicitly assumed.
reason.identity_mismatch: Host, boot, process or recorded service lifetime differs.
reason.identity_verified: Host, boot, main PID and process start ticks match.
reason.legacy_match: Legacy PID, service start time, restart count and cgroup path match.
reason.legacy_unknown: Host, boot and cgroup generation remain unverified in legacy input.
reason.identity_missing: Required identity evidence is missing; this is not a confirmed mismatch.
reason.legacy_accepted: The legacy continuity assumption was explicitly enabled.
reason.legacy_not_accepted: Legacy counter comparison requires explicit acceptance of the continuity assumption.
reason.cgroup_mismatch: Cgroup scope differs; cgroup counters cannot be compared temporally.
reason.unavailable: No recognized explanation was established from the supplied evidence.
stop.end_of_directory: End of directory; review completeness and errors.
stop.time_budget: Time budget reached; last checkpoint retained.
stop.entry_budget: Entry budget reached; partial observations retained.
stop.worker_incomplete: Worker did not provide a valid complete result.
stop.store_path_unresolved: Store directory could not be established.
stop.scanner_unavailable: Scanner could not be started or observed.
scope.supervisor: Supervisor process only; excludes collection worker and scanners.
scope.collector_worker: Collection worker only; excludes scanners and helper commands.
scope.unknown: Process accounting scope was not established.
usage_partial: Incomplete checkpoint: measured cost covers only work observed so far.
cleanup_pending_note: Kill was requested; worker exit was not observed within the cleanup grace.
footer: Doctor Fibre Kit v0.1 · Evidence before conclusions
finding.storage_budget.title: Logical occupancy and storage budget
finding.storage_budget.impact: Logical occupancy and budget are application accounting; neither equals filesystem usage or staging bytes.
finding.storage_budget.recommendation: Compare verified occupancy and budget metrics separately from measured directory and filesystem bytes.
finding.storage_budget.verification: Confirm the same Fibre target, metric freshness, budget mode and valid nonnegative values.
finding.shared_data_filesystem.title: Data filesystem sharing
finding.shared_data_filesystem.impact: Services on the same filesystem compete for available space. Different device IDs alone do not prove separate physical disks.
finding.shared_data_filesystem.recommend: Account for other services when evaluating storage headroom.
finding.shared_data_filesystem.verificat: Resolve service data directories to filesystem identities and verify topology separately.
